label: Diagram 6.2
caption: Diagram 6.2 Electric vehicle charge point locations which may serve more than one parking space
description: This is a top-down plan diagram showing four parked electric vehicles, drawn as grey car shapes, within parking bays outlined by thin grey lines. The bays form two groups. On the right, two bays lie side by side, holding a car numbered 1 on the left and a car numbered 2 on the right. Above them is a green square charge point box labelled A, from which two green cables run downwards, one to the front of car 1 and one to the front of car 2. On the left, two bays are stacked one above the other, containing car 3 at the top and car 4 at the bottom. A green square charge point box labelled B sits between these two cars on their right-hand side, with one green cable reaching the right side of car 3 and another reaching the top of car 4. To the right of car 4, two lines of text state: "Position A may serve parking spaces 1 and 2" and "Position B may serve parking spaces 3 and 4". A green footer bar carries the title "Diagram 6.2 Electric vehicle charge point locations which may serve more than one parking space".
